headline: Strategic Posts Change Hands on Six Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns show the battle still concentrated along a handful of unsettled sectors, though the picture has shifted since the previous edition. WeatheredExpanseHex remains the chief storm centre, with 57 strategic-base events in the past day and six in the latest two hours; its ledger stands at six Colonial and three Warden bases. FishermansRowHex has quickened to 27 daily events and 12 in two hours, holding seven Colonial and two Warden bases. CallahansPassageHex records 25 daily events, though only three in the latest two hours, with eight Warden and two Colonial bases. StlicanShelfHex has risen to 15 daily events and six recently, its balance four Warden to five Colonial. MooringCountyHex is active but comparatively quieter, with ten daily events and three in two hours, while StemaLandingHex reports eight daily and two recent, including one base currently neutral. PalantineBermHex has fallen quiet despite seven daily events, and most other sectors show no strategic-base movement. These six active fronts therefore offer the clearest guide to possible ownership changes during the next day.
